run_make_dist_html: run the script to generate an HTML page listing libuv release tags from git
build_version_parser: build a function that parses a version tag like v1.2.3 into a list of integers
create_major_minor_extractor: create a function that extracts the major and minor version numbers from a tag string
generate_release_row: generate an HTML table row for a release tag with optional gpg and exe links
build_release_group_table: build an HTML table grouping release tags by major and minor version
